user.title: Select HDL gateway
user.description:
{count} HDL gateway(s) found on this network (search uses a LAN broadcast).
If the list is empty, Home Assistant is usually on a different subnet than the gateway. Enter the gateway IP below (e.g. 192.168.1.150), or a subnet to probe (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).

manual.title: Enter gateway IP manually
manual.description: Enter the LAN IP of the HDL main gateway (MGWIP / LINK gateway). The integration reads the function and scene lists from the gateway and lists what can be added.

entities.title: Select functions
entities.description: Gateway {host} ({oid}) exposes {total} functions: {supported} supported, {unsupported} with an unsupported type. The list comes from the gateway function table, not from scanned devices.

secret.title: Local encryption key (optional)
secret.description: The gateway pushes property updates as locally encrypted payloads. Enter the 16-character local key supplied by the installer to decode them in real time. Leave it empty to rely on polling only; control and state still work.

scenes.title: Select scenes
scenes.description: Found {count} scene(s) on the gateway. Selected scenes become scene buttons. You may leave it empty.

reconfigure.title: Change gateway address
reconfigure.description: Currently connected to {gw} ({host}, {count} functions). If the gateway moved to a new IP, change the address here; the integration reconnects and verifies the gateway identity. Existing functions and entities stay unchanged.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway: check the IP, network reachability and that the gateway allows local connections.
error.no_functions: Connected, but no function was returned. Make sure the gateway project has devices configured.
error.need_host: Pick a gateway from the list, or fill in the gateway IP / subnet.
error.invalid_host: Unrecognized address. Use an IP (e.g. 192.168.1.150) or a subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).
error.wrong_gateway: A different HDL gateway answered on this address (gateway id mismatch). Enter the new address of the original gateway, or add this gateway as a new hub.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Gateway address updated; the integration has been reloaded.

init.title: HDL LINK options
init.description: Gateway {host}: device state changes are pushed by the gateway, so no polling is needed. Optionally set a fallback poll interval (seconds); 0 disables polling.
